title: Duke researchers' brain implants let paralyzed people control robot arms and walk

tellings.quote: there's Dano and this guy at um Duke who um implant electrodes in the brain of people who uh are paralyzed.

plain: Researchers at Duke University, including a scientist the teller calls Dano, put electrodes into the brains of paralyzed people, who could then control robot arms and even walk. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, the US electronic spying agency, tells Michels about this work, which he connects to a talk at the Aspen Institute, a policy forum. He brings it up as proof that the brain can be wired directly to machines.
